subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata, with `--deep` remaining the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but it changes the status-readiness contract from current-process probe state to persisted index-state evidence.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers want plain status to answer whether a prior vector index exists without loading sqlite-vec or embeddings.

options.title: Require Live Readiness Semantics
options.body: Ask for different wording or a separate indexed-vector field if `Vector store: ready` must always mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For Replacement Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers want a broader memory status contract before merging.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers want plain status to answer whether a prior vector index exists without loading sqlite-vec or embeddings.
